1033091.name: Bhai Special Mutton Tehari with Borhani
1033091.description: Enjoy the rich, aromatic depth of our slow-cooked mutton, expertly infused into every grain of premium, spiced rice. To balance the bold, savory indulgence of the Tehari, we serve it with our signature chilled Borhani—a tangy, herb-infused yogurt drink that cleanses the palate and makes every bite feel as vibrant as the first. It is the ultimate pairing for a complete, satisfying, and authentically traditional feast.

1033070.name: Bhai Special Mutton Tehari

We slow-cook tender, succulent mutton pieces with a proprietary blend of aromatic spices until they are melt-in-your-mouth perfect. Infused into every grain of our premium, fragrant rice, the bold, savory depth of the meat creates an unforgettable, authentic experience. It’s a rich, hearty, and nostalgic plate of comfort that defines the true essence of classic Tehari.

1032983.name: Halka Jhaler Beef Chaap
1032983.description: Experience the perfect balance of spice and tenderness with our Halka Jhaler Beef Chaap. We take succulent, premium cuts of beef and marinate them in a secret blend of aromatic spices, slow-cooking them until the meat is incredibly tender. Prepared "Halka Jhal" style, it offers a gentle, flavorful warmth that highlights the richness of the beef without being overwhelming. Deeply savory and perfectly charred, this is a must-try classic for those who appreciate authentic, well-balanced heat.

177025.name: Doi
177025.description: Complete your meal on a refreshing note with our Traditional Sweet Doi. Expertly set to a smooth, velvety consistency, this classic dessert offers the perfect balance of creamy richness and subtle sweetness. Chilled to perfection, it is the ultimate palate cleanser and a quintessential end to any hearty, spice-filled feast. Enjoy the authentic, melt-in-your-mouth experience that only premium, farm-fresh curd can provide.

1033036.name: Halka Jhaler Beef Chaap with Polao
1033036.description: Savor the perfect blend of tradition and comfort. Our succulent beef chaap is slow-cooked in a signature "halka jhal" (mildly spiced) marinade, offering a gentle, flavorful heat that perfectly complements the rich, tender meat. Served with a generous portion of aromatic, fluffy polao, this hearty duo is a timeless classic crafted to satisfy your cravings.

973544.name: Malai Lassi
